Nadia Ruiz: Uploaded the latest launch post (v_final) to Drive: https://drive.redwood/content/launch-vfinal
Ethan Cole: Quick scan 0— need to decide hero CTA routing: webinar microsite vs gated benchmark PDF. I vote hero -> webinar to capture signups.
Priya Nair: Agreed. Primary CTA -> webinar signup. Secondary CTA in the bench section -> download full PDF (methods). Suggest microcopy under CTA: 'Seats limited 0— register for webinar.'
Jordan V: Bench numbers look strong. From the run (2026-03-20) on the docs-qa workload (oak-14b quantized): 52% lower per-token cost vs baseline; p50 latency 88ms. We'll cite that in the methods.
Nadia Ruiz: Jordan, paste the exact hero subhead we should use.
Jordan V: Use: 'Real docs-qa tests (oak-14b, 2026-03-20) show up to 52% lower per-token cost with caching and batching.'
Ethan Cole: Nice. Legal: avoid absolutes like 'guarantee' and 'best' 0— replace with 'validated in our tests'. Also avoid 'enterprise-ready' without context.
LegalLead: Confirmed. Please add a short disclaimer in methods: 'Results may vary based on workload and configuration.' I'll review the redlines after you apply them.
Priya Nair: For UTMs, ops prefers: campaign=launch-summer26, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero-webinar|bench-pdf. Example:
?utm_campaign=launch-summer26&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero-webinar
Sam - Ops: Inbound routing: webinar signups get lead_score=70 and are assigned to SDR_Priority for first 96 hours when region_hint in ['EMEA','UK']; otherwise SDR_NA_Priority. After 96 hours, reassign to SDR_Longtail. Add nurture_path=post-launch-webinar in payload.
CRMBot: webhook validation OK. Sample payload validated (using single-quoted fields for readability):
{'email':'{{email}}','first_name':'{{first_name}}','utm_campaign':'launch-summer26','utm_content':'hero-webinar','region_hint':'{{region_hint}}','lead_score':'70','nurture_path':'post-launch-webinar'}
Ethan Cole: Tiny copy tweak: hero CTA should be 'See benchmarks & register' instead of 'Register now' 0— sets expectations.
Nadia Ruiz: Noted. Accessibility: alt text for hero chart should read: 'Cost vs latency comparison for oak-14b on docs-qa workload (A100-80GB)'. Ensure SVG has an accessible <title>.
Priya Nair: Also request we optimize hero image so page load stays under 1.5s on mobile. Ops, can you confirm CDN optimization and image compression?
Sam - Ops: CDN set to staging cache rules; we'll run image optimization and ensure next-gen formats. I'll drop the UTM CSV and routing rules in #ops by 11:30 PT.
Jordan V: I'll do a final check of the bench repo links and methods anchor at 10:45 PT.
LegalLead: I can sign off by 15:00 PT provided the language changes are applied and the methods note is present.
Nadia Ruiz: Goal: lock copy by 15:30 PT, staging publish at 21:00 PT. Webhook dry-run scheduled for 20:30 PT.
